PewterCity_House2_Text_MonsLearnTechniqu:
POKéMON learn new techniques as they grow.
But some moves must be taught to them by people.
PewterCity_House2_Text_MonsEasierCatchIf:
A POKéMON becomes easier to  catch if it has a status problem.
Sleep, poison, burn, or paralysis… Those are all effective.
But catching POKéMON is never a sure thing!
